evidence: During the precursor dosing step of the ALD recipe, this precursor was dosed into the reactor using Ar as a carrier gas, yielding a pressure of 4.0 × 10−2 mbar inside the chamber; dosing lasted for 6 s. Subsequently, the CoCp2 dosing line and reactor were purged with Ar for 3 s and then the reactor was pumped down for 6 s. As a co-reactant step, NH3 plasma was applied for 10 s.
